findings.issue: H3588 is only a conjunction; cuando selects the temporal sense and closes if/because.
The carcass noun is singular, but the suffix is 3rd masculine plural. su does not mark a plural possessor.
The suffix is 3rd masculine singular. ella is feminine, agreeing with semilla.

notes: Hophal se diere, plural aguas, qal cayere, singular cadáver, verbless impuro él, and לכם as a ustedes match the tokens.
